description: Matomo Tracking API hits to matomo.php on Matomo Cloud. Self-hosted matomo.php on other hosts is not contracted.

params.name: idsite
params.description: It is the numeric Matomo site ID the hit is recorded against.
params.fix_hint: Set `idsite` to the website ID from Matomo Administration.

params.name: rec
params.description: Matomo documents `rec=1` as required to record the request.
params.fix_hint: Set `rec` to `1`.

params.name: action_name
params.description: Matomo documents `action_name` as recommended. For page tracks it is the page title.
params.fix_hint: Set `action_name` to the page title or action name.

params.name: url
params.description: Matomo documents `url` as recommended. It is the full URL of the current action.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in `url`.

params.name: _id
params.description: Matomo documents `_id` as recommended. It is a 16-character hexadecimal visitor ID.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable 16-character hex visitor ID in `_id`.

params.name: rand
params.description: Matomo documents `rand` as recommended so the request is not cached.
params.fix_hint: Send a unique `rand` on every hit.

params.name: apiv
params.description: Matomo documents `apiv=1` as the Tracking API version.
params.fix_hint: Send `apiv=1`.

params.name: cid
params.description: It forces the visitor ID. Matomo documents `cid` as a 16-character hexadecimal string.
params.fix_hint: Send a 16-character hex visitor ID in `cid`, or use `_id` / `uid` instead.

params.name: e_v
params.description: It is the event value. Matomo documents it as a float or integer, not a string label.
params.fix_hint: Send a number in `e_v`, such as `9.99`.

params.name: e_c
params.description: It is the event category. Matomo documents it as required for event tracking and forbids an empty value.
params.fix_hint: Set `e_c` to the event category, such as `Videos`.

params.name: e_a
params.description: It is the event action. Matomo documents it as required for event tracking and forbids an empty value.
params.fix_hint: Set `e_a` to the event action, such as `Play`.

params.name: e_n
params.description: It is the event name. Matomo documents `e_n` as optional and forbids an empty value when it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Set `e_n` to the event name, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: idgoal
params.description: It is the goal ID. Matomo documents `idgoal=0` as required for ecommerce cart and order hits.

params.name: ec_id
params.description: It is the unique ecommerce order id. Matomo documents it as required when tracking an ecommerce order.
params.fix_hint: Set `ec_id` to the order id when `idgoal=0` is an order, not a cart update.

params.name: revenue
params.description: It is the grand total or goal conversion value. Matomo documents it as required when tracking an ecommerce order.
params.fix_hint: Set `revenue` to a number, such as `19.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: urlref
params.description: It is the HTTP referrer URL. Matomo documents `urlref` as the full referrer used for channel attribution.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute referrer URL in `urlref`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: uid
params.description: It is the User ID. Matomo documents `uid` as any non-empty unique string identifying the logged-in user.
params.fix_hint: Send the logged-in user id in `uid`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: res
params.description: It is the device resolution. Matomo documents `res` as width x height, such as `1280x1024`.
params.fix_hint: Send `res` as `WIDTHxHEIGHT` digits, such as `1280x1024`.

params.name: h
params.description: It is the current hour in local time.
params.fix_hint: Send the local hour in `h` as an integer.

params.name: m
params.description: It is the current minute in local time.
params.fix_hint: Send the local minute in `m` as an integer.

params.name: s
params.description: It is the current second in local time.
params.fix_hint: Send the local second in `s` as an integer.

params.name: cookie
params.description: When set to `1`, the visitor's client is known to support cookies.
params.fix_hint: Send `cookie=1` when the client supports cookies, or omit the pair.

params.name: new_visit
params.description: If set to `1`, Matomo forces a new visit for this action.
params.fix_hint: Send `new_visit=1` to force a new visit, or omit the pair.

params.name: ping
params.description: If set to `1`, the request is a heartbeat that only updates visit duration.
params.fix_hint: Send `ping=1` for a heartbeat, or omit the pair.

params.name: pv_id
params.description: It identifies actions on one page view. Matomo documents `pv_id` as six characters from `[0-9a-Z]`.
params.fix_hint: Send a six-character alphanumeric `pv_id`, shared by events on the same page view.

params.name: search
params.description: It is the site-search keyword. Matomo documents that a hit with `search` is tracked as a site search, not a pageview.
params.fix_hint: Send the search keyword in `search`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: search_count
params.description: It is how many site-search results were shown. Matomo documents `search_count=0` for keywords with no results.
params.fix_hint: Send the result count in `search_count` as an integer, including `0`.

params.name: pdf
params.description: It is a visitor plugin flag. Matomo documents `fla`, `java`, `dir`, `qt`, `realp`, `pdf`, `wma`, `gears`, and `ag` as `1` when that plugin is present.
params.fix_hint: Send `1` for a present plugin, or omit the pair.

params.name: c_n
params.description: It is the content name. Matomo documents `c_n` on content impressions and interactions.
params.fix_hint: Send the content name in `c_n`, such as `Ad Foo Bar`.

params.name: c_p
params.description: It is the content piece. Matomo documents `c_p` as the path to the image, video, audio, or text.
params.fix_hint: Send the content piece in `c_p`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: c_t
params.description: It is the content target. Matomo documents `c_t` as the landing-page URL.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute landing URL in `c_t`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: c_i
params.description: It is the content interaction, such as `click`. Matomo documents `c_i` together with `c_n`.
params.fix_hint: Send the interaction name in `c_i`, such as `click`.

params.name: ec_items
params.description: It is the JSON array of cart or order rows. Matomo documents each row as sku, name, category, price, quantity.
params.fix_hint: Send `ec_items` as a JSON array of item rows, such as `["sku","name","cat",11.11,2]`.

params.name: ec_st
params.description: It is the ecommerce subtotal, excluding shipping.
params.fix_hint: Send `ec_st` as a number, with no currency symbol.

params.name: ec_tx
params.description: It is the tax amount of the ecommerce order.
params.fix_hint: Send `ec_tx` as a number, with no currency symbol.

params.name: ec_sh
params.description: It is the shipping cost of the ecommerce order.
params.fix_hint: Send `ec_sh` as a number, with no currency symbol.

params.name: ec_dt
params.description: It is the discount offered on the ecommerce order.
params.fix_hint: Send `ec_dt` as a number, with no currency symbol.

params.name: dimension1
params.description: It is a custom dimension. Matomo documents `dimension1` through `dimension999`.
params.fix_hint: Fill the custom dimension, or drop the empty pair.

rules.message: The hit sends an event category `e_c` without an event action `e_a`. Matomo documents both as required for event tracking.
rules.fix_hint: Set `e_a` to the event action, such as `Play`.

rules.message: The hit tracks an ecommerce order (`ec_id`) without `revenue`. Matomo documents the grand total as required on an order.
rules.fix_hint: Set `revenue` to the order grand total, and set `idgoal=0`.

rules.message: The hit sends a content interaction `c_i` without a content name `c_n`. Matomo documents both on a content interaction.
rules.fix_hint: Set `c_n` to the same content name as the impression, such as `Ad Foo Bar`.
